title: Orrery Music Box
tagline: Hang planets on seven rings and let them ring the gate.
how_to: Tap to begin (sound on), then tap a ring to hang a planet; tap a planet to remove it.
description: Seven concentric rings turn at seven different speeds, outer ones low and slow, inner ones high and quick. Each planet you hang rings a bell when it sweeps past the golden gate at the top. Stack planets on different rings and listen to polyrhythms drift in and out of phase, then press Surprise for a random system.
spark: Orbit taken literally: planets circling a sun become a rhythm machine.
proud_of: Every ring's speed is a whole-number multiple of the slowest, so all the rhythms realign every cycle and the pattern always resolves.
